text: At e<=0.9 the linear accel_step R2 is flat from about step 1000-2250 onward, while val_mse_ratio falls about 10x (0.12 to 0.013). On the same checkpoints, does a log(accel_step) or small-MLP probe keep gaining R2 over steps 1000-3000? That would show whether the late accuracy goes into a nonlinear pericentre code that the linear probe cannot read.
